en: The Great Uṣṇīṣa Tathāgata’s Radiant Sitātapatrā Dhāraṇī,
translated by the Tripiṭaka Śramaṇa Amoghavajra of Daxingshan Monastery, by Imperial Decree.

Namo surūḍhapānām | Namo sakṛttagamiṇām | Namo 'nāgamīṇām | Namo lukisamyag-gatānāṃ samyak-pratipannānām | Namo ratnānām |
